title: Alto Adventure
identity: David Jex’s Alto Adventure is an original short alto saxophone and piano work for Lynn Klock, available from Wingert-Jones. A recording by Lynn Klock with the Virginia Wind Symphony appears on Links: New Concertos for Saxophone and Wind Ensemble, apparently a wind-ensemble performance; keep this separate from the piano edition.

evidence.claim: Retailer describes a brief work for alto sax and piano with driving accompaniment, lyrical upper-register melodies, technical passages, and a fast build to a close; composed for Lynn Klock.
Wingert-Jones lists Alto Adventure among David Jex works.
Spotify identifies a 5:41 recording by David Jex, performed by Lynn Klock and Virginia Wind Symphony, on a wind-ensemble concerto album.

review_focus: Inference from edition description: upper-register singing tone, contrast between lyric and virtuosic passages, stamina into accelerated ending, and piano coordination deserve review.
collection_flag: Original work written for a university saxophonist; known piano edition and separate wind-ensemble recording demonstrate performance options.

listening.description: Lynn Klock with Virginia Wind Symphony, 5:41; wind-ensemble recording.
listening.verification: Track and credits listed; audio not auditioned.

gaps: Piano edition and wind-ensemble recording relationship should be confirmed against the solo part.
